checks.evidence: Facade and supervisor expose only the four GOVERNSEED proxy identity variables; forbidden provider and Git credential variables are excluded from the measured proxy environment.
Proxy policy accepts only OpenAI HTTPS endpoint https://api.openai.com/v1/responses.
Proxy startup and request validation require one exact non-alias model; request model must equal the startup binding.
Unknown, x-*, Authorization, OpenAI-Organization, and OpenAI-Project client headers are rejected; framing headers are accepted locally and never forwarded.
Only host proxy transport constructs the upstream Authorization header; receipts and logs receive no authorization value.
Request top-level and metadata field sets are exact; forbidden tool, URL, background, store, and service-tier fields are not accepted.
Request metadata run_id must equal the run binding captured at proxy startup.
Request metadata benchmark_id must equal GS-OSS-2026-08-02-V8 captured at proxy startup.
Synthetic UDS start verifies socket type, explicit UID/GID, and mode 0600 on a run-scoped unique path.
Synthetic server error removes the socket and an in-flight client observes a failed connection.
Partial-body disconnect and child-process crash trigger proxy close, abort upstream work, and remove the socket.
Synthetic clock timeout aborts pending upstream work, closes the proxy, and removes the socket.
Repair source, schemas, tests, and packet use requestLimit 1 and proxy timeoutMs 30000; runtime execution timeout remains a separately bounded container wait input.

gaps: Exact measured model candidate remains pending human selection.

claimBoundary: Synthetic local proxy evidence closes the inherited technical blockers but does not establish provider access, runtime identity, task execution, G3, Pilot, scoring, or benchmark acceptance.
